title: Completed polynomial conormal differential
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal and $r\geq0$ an integer. Write $Q=A[x_1,\ldots,x_r]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] and $P=\widehat Q_{IQ}$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. The continuous partial derivative $\partial_i:P\to P$ is the unique $A$-linear map extending the polynomial partial derivative and preserving $(IP)^n$ for every $n\geq0$. For an ideal $J\subseteq P$ set $E=P/J$. The completed polynomial conormal differential is the induced $A$-linear map $\delta:J/J^2\to E^{\oplus r}$, $[f]\mapsto(\partial_i f\bmod J)_i$. It is well-defined because the continuous Leibniz rule gives $\partial_i(J^2)\subseteq J$.
